patronOf.pt-BR: Jejum e oração na semana de Pentecostes

prayerExcerpt.en-US: The charity of God is poured forth in our hearts, alleluia: by His Spirit dwelling in us, alleluia, alleluia.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O amor de Deus espalhou-se nos nossos corações, aleluia: pelo seu Espírito que habita em nós, aleluia, aleluia.

meta.basis: The Pentecost Ember Days fall within the octave of Pentecost and are kept in red in the traditional missal (Divinum Officium's liturgical_color: 'Quattuor Temporum Pentecostes'; the Portuguese missal's note 'Paramentos vermelhos'). Summer fields for the fruits of the earth; the young man in a cassock for the ordinations held on Ember Saturdays (Catechism of St. Pius X, part III, ch. IV, q. 23).
meta.excerpt: content/do/web/www/missa/English/Tempora/Pasc7-6.txt and Portugues/Tempora/Pasc7-6.txt [Introitus], Ember Saturday of Pentecost (the antiphon whole, verbatim in both languages)
